sources.summary: Dezeen School Shows: a proposal for a waterside repair and reuse hub exploring craft, material reuse and environmental stewardship is among projects from the University of Plymouth. Also featured is a regenerative laboratory restoring Plymouth Sound's seabed and a proposal to transform polluted harbour water into a resource for marine research, industry and public engagement. The post Waterfront repair and craft hub among projects from University of Plymouth appeared first on Dezeen .
